Maya P.: Optima follow-up: they want GovCloud private deploy + HSM + strict latency SLO (p95 < 120ms @512). Can we sketch a short runbook and owners today? @Noor @Aria @Amy
Aria (eng-runtime): Quick reality check: achievable if we do model quantization, single-request batching, and prewarmed pinned nodes. Need a pinned build for GovCloud AMI. Perf testing on our side first.
Noor (eng-infra): GovCloud provisioning + marketplace AMI approvals are the long poles. ETA ~5 business days if account info + permissions provided ASAP. Also need a prewarm autoscale policy (keep N warm nodes).
Amy (sec): HSM onboarding requires documented key policy and a contact at Optima. Also need syslog/SIEM forwarding + approval for audit retention. I'll email the compliance checklist.
Jessie K.: Product wants a short canary (3 steps over 10 days), rollback criteria: >1% errors OR p95 >150ms for 10m. Need automation for circuit-breaker.
Maya P.: They asked for launch week May 10–14. Is that still realistic if we start now?
Noor (eng-infra): tight. If Optima hands over account id + compliance POC today we can request GovCloud capacity and AMI. I'll open infra ticket: INF-8421. Will add prewarm policy suggestion.
Aria (eng-runtime): I'll kick off a quant int8 build and run perf suite against local A100 nodes. Test plan: ```- smoke 1k reqs @ batch=1
- p50/p95/p99 for 128/256/512 tokens
- with/without KV prefix cache
- streaming vs non-streaming paths``` ETA results: 72 hours.
release-bot: New ticket created: INF-8421 by Noor.
Liam O.: I'll own the rollout toggle and automated rollback wiring (feature-flag + metrics alert). Will add a healthcheck endpoint that returns runtime metrics (latency, error-rate, kv-cache hit).
Amy (sec): Checklist items (short): ```
- customer key policy signed
- HSM contract in place
- SIEM endpoint + log format agreed
- IAM roles for GovCloud AMI
``` Need Optima sig by Apr 22 to hit May 10.
Maya P.: Action items recap: Maya -> get Optima account + compliance POC today; Noor -> open infra ticket + request AMI approval (INF-8421); Aria -> perf tests and pinned build (72h); Liam -> rollout toggle + runbook; Amy -> send checklist and follow up with Optima. Everyone ok with owners?
Aria (eng-runtime): Confirm.
Noor (eng-infra): Confirm, will attach capacity estimate to INF-8421. Initial suggestion: 4 A100-equivalent nodes steady, scale to 8 for spikes, prewarm 2 nodes.
Liam O.: Confirm. I'll draft the runbook skeleton: steps to route traffic, smoke tests, rollback command (feature-flag off), and postmortem triggers.
Jessie K.: I'll prepare the canary schedule and acceptance tests and add to the PRD.
Amy (sec): I'll schedule a 1:1 with Optima compliance to close open items.
Maya P.: Thanks — first sync tomorrow 9:30am PT. I'll drop Optima contact info into this thread when I have it. :calendar:
